draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.86, the 192nd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 9th of 14 at QB. He went 139th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (192nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (83rd percentile), three-cone (88th percentile), vertical jump (94th percentile). College production: his final season (2022) ranked 2nd in passing yards among the 14 QBs in his class with stats.
